name: sensor-manufacturing-mes
description: 센서 제조의 생산·자재·품질·LOT 계보를 연결하는 MES

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/api typecheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/web test && corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/api test
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @sensor-mes/api build
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm docs:check
